do echo "Checking $REGION..." # Get all security groups ALL_SGs=$(aws ec2 describe-security-groups --region "$REGION" --query 'SecurityGroups[*].GroupId' --output text) for SG in $ALL_SGs; do # Check if security group is used by any instance INSTANCE_COUNT=$(aws ec2 describe-instances --region "$REGION" \ --filters "Name=instance.group-id,Values=$SG" \ --query 'length(Reservations[*].Instances[*][])' --output text 2>/dev/null || echo "0") if [ "$INSTANCE_COUNT" == "0" ] || [ -z "$INSTANCE_COUNT" ]; then LTS=$(aws ec2 describe-launch-templates --region "$REGION" --query 'LaunchTemplates[*].LaunchTemplateId' --output text) for LT in $LTS; do VERSION=$(aws ec2 describe-launch-template-versions --launch-template-id "$LT" --region "$REGION" \ --query 'LaunchTemplateVersions[0].VersionNumber' --output text 2>/dev/null) if [ -n "$VERSION" ]; subprocess.run( ['aws', 'ec2', 'describe-security-groups', '--region', region, '--query', 'SecurityGroups[*].[GroupId,GroupName,VpcId,GroupDescription]', '--output', 'json'], capture_output=True, text=True ) return json.loads(result.stdout) except: return [] def get_instances_in_region(region): """Get all instances and their security groups""" try: result = subprocess.run( ['aws', 'ec2', 'describe-instances', '--region', region, '--query', 'Reservations[*].Instances[*].[InstanceId,SecurityGroups[*].GroupId]', '--output', 'json'], capture_output=True, text=True ) instances = json.loads(result.stdout) used_sgs = set() for reservation in instances: for instance in reservation: if len(instance) > 1 and instance[1]: used_sgs.update(instance[1]) return used_sgs except: return set() def get_launch_templates_in_region(region): """Get all launch templates and their security groups""" used_sgs = set() try: result = subprocess.run( ['aws', 'ec2', 'describe-launch-templates', '--region', region, '--query', 'LaunchTemplates[*].LaunchTemplateId', '--output', 'json'], capture_output=True, text=True ) template_ids = json.loads(result.stdout) for template_id in template_ids: result = subprocess.run( ['aws', 'ec2', 'describe-launch-template-versions', '--launch-template-id', template_id, '--region', region, '--query', 'LaunchTemplateVersions[0].LaunchTemplateData.SecurityGroupIds', '--output', 'json'], capture_output=True, text=True ) if result.stdout and result.stdout.strip() != 'null': sgs = json.loads(result.stdout) if sgs: used_sgs.update(sgs) except: pass return used_sgs def get_network_interfaces_in_region(region): """Get all network interfaces and their security groups""" try: result = subprocess.run( ['aws', 'ec2', 'describe-network-interfaces', '--region', region, '--query', 'NetworkInterfaces[*].Groups[*].GroupId', '--output', 'json'], capture_output=True, text=True ) interfaces = json.loads(result.stdout) used_sgs = set() for interface_sgs in interfaces: used_sgs.update(interface_sgs) return used_sgs except: return set() regions = ['us-east-1', 'us-west-1', 'us-west-2'] unused_by_region = {} for region in regions: all_sgs = get_security_groups_for_region(region) instance_sgs = get_instances_in_region(region) lt_sgs = get_launch_templates_in_region(region) eni_sgs = get_network_interfaces_in_region(region) used_sgs = instance_sgs | lt_sgs | eni_sgs unused_list = [] for sg_info in all_sgs: sg_id = sg_info[0] sg_name = sg_info[1] vpc_id = sg_info[2] description = sg_info[3] # Skip default security groups unless they're not used if sg_id not in used_sgs: unused_list.append({ 'GroupId': sg_id, 'GroupName': sg_name, 'VpcId': vpc_id, 'Description': description }) if unused_list: unused_by_region[region] = unused_list # Print results print("=" * 100) print("UNUSED SECURITY GROUPS BY REGION") print("=" * 100) print() if not unused_by_region: print("No unused security groups found.") else: for region in sorted(unused_by_region.keys()): print(f"\nREGION: {region}") print("-" * 100) for sg in
